title: Create: Simply Optimized - Mobile
description: This Modpack simply optimizes the NeoForge Version of Create, No Bloat, Nothing, Highly customizable, thank me later (Recommended for Mobile)
body:
I have now added a JEI version, but sometimes JEI menu is laggy, if you dont want to install it, please install from the versions tab, you may get the wrong version

looking for PC version? here!: https://modrinth.com/modpack/create-simply-optimized-pc

This Modpack... idk im new to creating, but This Modpack optimizes Create, and makes it playable for mobile, so you can finally make that factory you've been wanting to make in Mobile

Note: Use MobileGlues and allocate atleast 2 Gigs!!!
